verdict.rationale: Avalara documents an official AvaTax MCP server. The probe confirms it at developer.avalara.com/mcp-servers.md, and the MCP docs list concrete agent tools: tax calculation, transaction listing and lookup, nexus retrieval, and AI-powered tax code recommendations. The free trial explicitly includes access to the AvaTax MCP servers. Missing for 10: documented connection and authentication setup details (transport, client config), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
